name: 千机匣
text: 回合结束时，手牌留在手中，不再放入弃牌堆。代价：[手牌上限]从 10 降为 7。
flavor: 千机傀儡师的匣子。放进去的东西，一件也拿不出来。

art.subject: an intricate puppeteer's lacquered box with dozens of tiny drawers and gears, silk strings trailing from it, violet light

name: 残烛金灯
text: 每回合开始时，获得1枚本回合的[源]。每回合少抽1张牌。
flavor: 灯油只够照亮手边，照不到远处。

art.subject: an ornate golden oil lamp with a single guttering flame, bright at the wick but darkness closing in around it

name: 沉渊王印
text: 每回合开始时，获得1枚本回合的[源]。你无法在营地休息恢复生命。
flavor: 溺王殷的印。拿着它的人，再也睡不安稳。

art.subject: a heavy jade royal seal covered in barnacles and dripping black water, a drowned dragon carved on top, eerie green glow

name: 司命朱笔
text: 每回合开始时，获得1枚本回合的[源]。所有敌人攻击力+1。
flavor: 朱笔一勾，你多得一分，天下也多恨你一分。

art.subject: a long calligraphy brush with a vermilion-soaked tip, dripping red ink that glows like blood, over a floating open ledger

name: 裂命之书
text: 战斗开始时，获得2枚主帅主色的[源]。每回合可献牌为源的次数-1（通常即不能献牌）。
flavor: 撕下两页换来的力量，再也不能用别的东西去换。

art.subject: a thick ancient book split down the spine, two pages torn out and burning into glowing orbs of colored light

name: 执笔童子墨
text: [命签]上限+2。每回合开始时，获得1张[命签]。每回合少抽1张牌。
flavor: 童子研的墨，写什么都会成真——只是写得很慢。

art.subject: a small ink stick shaped like a sleeping child scribe, grinding in an ink stone that reflects a sky full of stars

name: 金乌之影
text: 所有角色的[灼烧]不再衰减。战斗开始时，对所有敌人施加4层[灼烧]，对你的主帅施加2层[灼烧]。
flavor: 三足金乌落下的影子，连执命者也一并烧着。

art.subject: the black silhouette of a three-legged crow cast across burning ground, its shadow itself made of flickering flames

name: 镇岳山心
text: 你的[应]牌费用-1。[余烬]上限+2。你的[源]上限-3。
flavor: 山心不动，所以山外的一切都来得及。

art.subject: a glowing blue crystal heart embedded inside a split boulder, slow pulses of light rippling through the stone

name: 噬名狐尾
text: 每回合开始时，获得1枚本回合的[源]。你的主帅受到的伤害+1。
flavor: 狐母吃掉的名字都在尾巴里。它们会在你受伤时一起叫出声。

art.subject: a single luxurious silver fox tail with faint ghostly faces shimmering within its fur, coiled on a dark altar

name: 母树之种
text: 每当友方单位入场，使其获得[滋长]1。拾取时，最大生命-10。
flavor: 种下它的人，要把自己的一部分也埋进土里。

art.subject: a huge glowing seed cracked open with a tiny world tree sprouting from it, roots curling around a drop of blood

name: 天机罗盘
text: 每回合多抽1张牌。拾取时，天命牌堆中加入3张1点{thunder}雷纹命牌。
flavor: 指针永远指向下一张牌，只是那张牌常常不吉。

art.subject: an ornate bronze divination compass with a spinning needle shaped like a tiny card, thunder sigils etched on its rim, crackling with faint lightning

name: 九转丹炉
text: 每场战斗结束时，恢复8点生命。拾取时，最大生命-4。
flavor: 九转之后，炉里炼出的是时间；你用来养伤。

art.subject: a small three-legged bronze alchemy furnace with nine rings on its lid, soft golden steam curling out, glowing coals beneath

name: 燎天军旗
text: 友方单位攻击力+1。你的主帅受到的伤害+1。
flavor: 旗在，阵就在；旗手总是第一个中箭。

art.subject: a tattered crimson war banner on a tall spear pole, embroidered with a flaming character, whipping in the wind above smoke

name: 铁誓兵符
text: 战斗开始时，获得12点[护甲]。每回合少抽1张牌。
flavor: 半枚虎符，另一半在一个再也回不来的人手里。

art.subject: half of an ancient bronze tiger-shaped military tally with inlaid gold script, its broken edge jagged, resting on dark iron armor scales

name: 血契
text: 每当你献出一张牌，抽1张牌。我方回合开始时，失去1点生命。
flavor: 契约写在掌心，每一笔都要拿血来描。

art.subject: a narrow scroll of pale paper signed with a bloody handprint and red seal, a thin trail of blood seeping along its edge

name: 坠星灯
text: 你的[判定]点数+2。敌人的攻击伤害+1。
flavor: 星星落进灯里，照亮了命数，也照亮了你。

art.subject: a hanging paper lantern with a small falling star trapped inside, trailing golden sparks, starry night background

name: 万毒葫芦
text: 敌人受到的[中毒]伤害+2。拾取时，最大生命-10。
flavor: 葫芦里装的不是药，是一万种不肯救人的法子。

art.subject: a lacquered double gourd painted with violet serpents, a thin green venom mist leaking from its cork stopper

name: 寒山钟
text: 我方回合开始时，至多保留10点[护甲]。你的攻击伤害-1。
flavor: 钟声一响，山里的寒气就不再散。

art.subject: a heavy bronze temple bell rimmed with frost and icicles, mountain pattern cast on its side, hanging in cold blue mist

name: 孤注之刃
text: 你的攻击伤害+2。你无法在营地休息恢复生命。
flavor: 只有一刀，所以要比谁都快。

art.subject: a single straight blade with no guard stabbed into bare rock, a strip of red cloth tied to its hilt, sharp moonlight on the edge

name: 铜雀台
text: 每回合你打出第3张牌后，获得1枚本回合的[源]。拾取时，失去所有金币。
flavor: 台上歌舞从不停歇，台下的金子一夜散尽。

art.subject: a small bronze sparrow statue perched on a miniature terrace pavilion, gold coins scattered and falling from the terrace edge
